description: Claude Code model swap configuration — rewrites the model IDs the Claude Code CLI asks for into the models this router serves, per Claude Code tier (fable/opus/plan/sonnet/haiku), so the tier mapping lives here instead of in ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL environment variables on every host.

claude_code_modes.name: fable
claude_code_modes.description: Fable tier: the most capable model, selected for the hardest and longest-running tasks, and what the 'best' alias resolves to. Replace model_name with the strongest model this router serves.

claude_code_modes.name: opus
claude_code_modes.description: Opus tier: complex reasoning and architecture work, selected with /model opus or the ANTHROPIC_MODEL environment variable.

claude_code_modes.name: plan
claude_code_modes.description: Plan tier: the opusplan alias, which runs Plan Mode on the reasoning model. Only reached when the CLI sends the alias unresolved; normally opusplan arrives as an Opus model ID and is served by the opus mode.

claude_code_modes.name: sonnet
claude_code_modes.description: Sonnet tier: daily coding work, the model a default Claude Code session runs on.

claude_code_modes.name: haiku
claude_code_modes.description: Haiku tier: simple requests and the background calls Claude Code runs on the small fast model (topic naming, summaries), formerly configured with ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL.
